title: Tangent Theorems and Problem Solving — Circles
hook: Let's explore Tangent Theorems and Problem Solving from the chapter on Circles. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Tangent Theorems and Problem Solving Two tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal in length. This leads to many elegant geometric results and numerical problems. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Theorem 2: Tangents from an external point are equal (PA = PB)
💡 The line from external point to centre bisects the angle between tangents
💡 OP bisects ∠APB and ∠AOB (O = centre, P = external point)
💡 In △OAP: OA² + AP² = OP² (right angle at A)
